semantic.comment: Schema versions applied to this store. v25 has no upgrade paths: an older store is rejected.

Accounts. Every notebook has a real owner rather than a null "everyone".
SQLite treats NULLs as distinct in a UNIQUE index, so any number of accounts may lack an email.
One-time email login codes, stored as a hash with an attempt counter so a leaked database yields no usable code and guessing is bounded.
Groups of notebooks (design-docs/specs/library.md). auth_required = 0 means anyone may reach the library.
Which authenticated users may reach a library that requires authentication.
A notebook belongs to one library and one owner.
Per-notebook content revision, incremented by every recorded notebook change and by page OCR completion. A translation pass completes only while it is unchanged. Kept outside the prunable action log.
Notes. For an imported document page the note is the anchor of its versions, memos, tags, links and AI discussion; the page itself lives in document_pages.

columns.name: note_number
columns.comment: Position in the notebook; for a document page it equals the physical page number.

semantic.comment:
One row per physical page of an imported document (design-docs/specs/note-store-schema-v25.md).
Page versions are a closed set: original = origin_file_id + page_number, ocr = text / text_status / text_source, translated = note_translations.

columns.name: origin_file_id
columns.comment: The original: the retained PDF (all pages share it) or the page image.

columns.name: page_number
columns.comment: Physical page number within the original, starting at 1.

columns.name: text_extraction_mode
columns.comment: PDFs only: prefer embedded text or OCR only.

columns.name: text
columns.comment: The OCR version: native PDF text or OCR output, plain text. Empty while pending.

columns.name: text_source
columns.comment: pdf-text or ocr; set exactly when text_status is complete.

columns.name: analysis_json
columns.comment: Page analysis: language, writing mode, binding, title.

checks.name: ck_document_pages_text_extraction_mode
checks.expression: text_extraction_mode IS NULL OR text_extraction_mode IN ('prefer-pdf-text', 'ocr-only')

checks.name: ck_document_pages_text_source
checks.expression: text_source IS NULL OR text_source IN ('pdf-text', 'ocr')

semantic.comment: The Translated version of a note: one body per note and language, replaced in place when the source text changes.

columns.name: source_sha256
columns.comment: Hash of the source text this translation was made from; a mismatch marks it outdated.

semantic.comment: One translation request: notebook, target language, optional inclusive page range, status, and the cursor and pass revision that let an outbox retry resume.

columns.name: continuation_note_id
columns.comment: Last note of the current pass known to be translated; NULL restarts the pass.

columns.name: source_revision
columns.comment: notebook_revisions.revision captured when the current pass began.

checks.name: ck_translation_jobs_page_range
checks.expression: (page_start IS NULL AND page_end IS NULL) OR (page_start >= 1 AND page_end >= page_start)

semantic.comment: Ontology classes of tags (Date, Name, Place, ...).
Tags. Folder tags form a tree through parent_tag_id; other tag names are unique.

columns.name: canonical_note_id
columns.comment: The note that describes this tag (E1). A column, so one note per tag is the schema's job; ON DELETE SET NULL clears it, and undo restores it from the deletion snapshot.

indexes.name: uq_tags_nested_folder_name
indexes.where: class_id = 'folder' AND parent_tag_id IS NOT NULL

semantic.comment: Tag assignments of notes.
Tag assignments of notebooks, including notebook-kind:* system tags.
Stored file content. Exactly one locator per storage kind: a migrated row drops its local path, and a local row has no S3 coordinates.

checks.name: ck_files_locator
checks.expression: (storage_kind = 'local' AND local_path IS NOT NULL AND s3_profile IS NULL AND s3_bucket IS NULL AND s3_key IS NULL) OR (storage_kind = 's3' AND local_path IS NULL AND s3_profile IS NOT NULL AND s3_bucket IS NOT NULL AND s3_key IS NOT NULL)

semantic.comment: Files attached to a note.
Files attached to a notebook; an imported document's original is its source-document.
Directed links between notes.
Memos attach to a note, to a whole notebook, or both (a note memo also records its notebook so notebook-wide listings need no join).

checks.name: ck_note_comments_anchor
checks.expression: note_id IS NOT NULL OR notebook_id IS NOT NULL

semantic.comment: Application settings as JSON documents keyed by setting name.
Workflow triggers on note and notebook events. Kaiba ships the default AI-tagging actions disabled.
Durable outbox of auto-action dispatches; the action is copied so a later edit does not change queued work.

Append-only per-actor action history behind undo/redo (design-docs/specs/action-history-undo.md). AUTOINCREMENT keeps seq monotonic across retention pruning; action names are owned by the code that writes them.
API keys. Only a hash of the token is stored.
One personal-agent provider credential per user. The key is never selected by any caller-facing read path.

Maps note_fts rows to notes. The FTS table is contentless, so a 'delete' must repeat the exact values that were inserted; the context payload is stored here because tag ancestry can change after indexing.
The external search engine index this store is synchronized with (singleton row).
Notes whose external search engine document must be written or deleted. note_id has no foreign key: deleted notes stay queued so their documents are removed.

semantic.name: Document page versions: original / ocr / translated

semantic.text:
Page versions are a closed set (design-docs/specs/note-store-schema-v25.md):
- original: document_pages.origin_file_id + page_number
- ocr: document_pages.text / text_status / text_source
- translated: note_translations (one per note and language)
A new version is a new definition here, never a runtime type.
